$comment: 编辑用分块，由 build.py 拼进 request.schema.json。

inspectRequest.description: 按 scope 看文件的一部分。
inspectRequest.descriptionEn: View part of the file according to scope.
inspectRequest.limits: 不要一次要整份文件。不带 scope 只返回名单，不返回单元格。xlsx 公式格的 value 是包里的缓存，没有缓存则为 null，库不算。改内容用 apply，不要把这次看到的树整份送回去当修改。
inspectRequest.limitsEn: Do not request the whole file at once. Without scope the result is only the list, not cells. An xlsx formula cell's value is the cached value in the package; it is null when there is no cache, and the library does not calculate it. To change content, use apply. Do not send the whole tree you just saw back as the edit.

inspectScope.limits: 三种格式的键不能混用。xlsx 看格子要同时给 sheet 和 range。没列出的键不要写。
inspectScope.limitsEn: Do not mix keys from the three formats. To view xlsx cells, give both sheet and range. Do not write keys that are not listed.

createRequest.description: 整包生成一份新文件。目标路径已存在则覆盖。
createRequest.descriptionEn: Generate a whole new file. An existing path is overwritten.
createRequest.limits: 改已有内容用 apply，不要靠 create 覆盖。xlsx 用 workbook，docx 用 document，pptx 用 presentation，三者不要同时写。
createRequest.limitsEn: To change existing content, use apply instead of overwriting with create. xlsx uses workbook, docx uses document, and pptx uses presentation. Do not write all three together.
createRequest.comment: path 必填。xlsx 用 workbook，docx 用 document，pptx 用 presentation，三者不能同时出现。

exportMediaRequest.description: 按 id 把图或嵌入对象的原始字节写到本地。
exportMediaRequest.descriptionEn: Write the original bytes of a picture or an embedded object to a local file, by id.
exportMediaRequest.limits: 不改源文件，字节也不进 inspect 树。
exportMediaRequest.limitsEn: Does not modify the source file, and the bytes are not placed in the inspect tree.
exportMediaRequest.comment: output 必填。不得默认写成源 path。

applyRequest.description: 用 id 和 op 改文件里点名的内容。
applyRequest.descriptionEn: Use id and op to change the named content in the file.
applyRequest.limits: 不要把整棵 inspect 树塞进请求。
applyRequest.limitsEn: Do not send the whole inspect tree back as the edit.

exportChartDataRequest.description: 把图表背后的工作簿数据导出。
exportChartDataRequest.descriptionEn: Export the workbook data behind a chart.
exportChartDataRequest.limitsEn: Does not modify the source file and does not evaluate formulas.
exportChartDataRequest.comment: output 必填。不得默认写成源 path。

exportChartImageRequest.description: 把 xlsx 簇状柱形图画成 PNG。
exportChartImageRequest.descriptionEn: Draw an xlsx clustered column chart to a PNG.
exportChartImageRequest.limits: 只读。不改源包，像素不进 inspect。只画簇状柱形图。系列优先用图里的缓存，没有时用公式所指格子里已有的缓存。docx 与 pptx 报 InvalidField。其余图报 NotImplemented。宽或高超出 1 到 4096 像素也报 NotImplemented。
exportChartImageRequest.limitsEn: Read only. Does not modify the source package, and pixels do not enter inspect. Only clustered column charts are drawn. A series uses the cache in the chart, or the cached cells its formula points at when that cache is absent. docx and pptx return InvalidField. Other charts return NotImplemented. Width or height outside 1 to 4096 pixels also returns NotImplemented.
exportChartImageRequest.comment: output 必填。不得默认写成源 path。contentType 固定为 image/png。

exportSparklineImageRequest.description: 把 xlsx 一组里的一条折线或非负柱形迷你图画成 PNG。
exportSparklineImageRequest.descriptionEn: Draw one line sparkline, or one non-negative column sparkline, in an xlsx group to a PNG.
exportSparklineImageRequest.limits: 只读。不改源包，像素不进 inspect。id 是 sheet:{name}/spark:{n}。一组只能有一条，落点只能是一个格子。折线可以画。柱形只在每个点都是非负数、没有空格子时画。盈亏、标记、高低点、首末点、负值、横坐标、日期轴、从右到左，以及柱形上的负数和空格子，报 NotImplemented。数值用包里已有的缓存。docx 与 pptx 报 InvalidField。宽或高超出能画的范围也报 NotImplemented。
exportSparklineImageRequest.limitsEn: Read only. Does not modify the source package, and pixels do not enter inspect. id is sheet:{name}/spark:{n}. The group must hold one sparkline, and the location must be one cell. A line can be drawn. A column is drawn only when every point is non-negative and present. Win/loss, markers, high and low points, first and last points, negatives, the axis, a date axis, right-to-left, and a column with a negative or an empty cell return NotImplemented. Values come from caches already in the package. docx and pptx return InvalidField. Width or height outside the drawable range also returns NotImplemented.
exportSparklineImageRequest.comment: output 必填。不得默认写成源 path。contentType 固定为 image/png。

exportSheetImageRequest.description: 把 xlsx 工作表的已用区域画成 PNG。
exportSheetImageRequest.descriptionEn: Draw an xlsx worksheet's used range to a PNG.
exportSheetImageRequest.limits: 只读。不改源包，像素不进 inspect。id 是 sheet:{名称}。图画 dimension 和格子外框的并集，只有一边时用那一边。像素按 Excel 复制为图片的 100% 格子，不乘工作表缩放。显式列宽用 floor(((256*宽度+floor(128/7))/256)*7)，缺省列 64 像素。行高把磅截成像素。没写 defaultRowHeight 时，空行是 14.25 磅（19 像素）。写了该属性但 customHeight 不是真时，不采用这个数字，空行按常规样式的行高。customHeight 为真时，空行和常规字体的行用写下的磅值。合并盖住的空行按锚点的字加高。自动行高只认微软雅黑一类字体乘 1.65，以及 Calibri 11 磅为 15 磅。宽高是各格之和再加 1。网格色 E0E0E0。纯色填充盖住格子右缘和下缘。上边和左边的外框保持网格色。showGridLines 为 0 或 false 时不画网格，外框留白，宽高不变。隐藏行和隐藏列不占像素，整边隐藏时这一边只留 1 像素白。条件格式碰到隐藏行列仍报 NotImplemented。rightToLeft 且没有文字、条件格式、自动筛选时整图水平翻转，有文字时仍报 NotImplemented。公式有缓存时用缓存，没有缓存时用库里的求值。合并单元格用锚点。数据条按最小最大、长度 10% 到 90%。两档或三档色阶按 RGB 混合。expression 公式能求值且差分是纯色时铺上该色，求不了报 NotImplemented。公式差分里已对齐的线型按格子边框画。dashed 和 slantDashDot 的差分边框报 NotImplemented。高于平均、前 N 和包含文本命中后铺纯色，标准差按总体算。重复值和唯一值按规则铺纯色。空白只认锚点上的 LEN(TRIM(锚点))=0 或 >0，错误值只认 ISERROR(锚点) 或 NOT(ISERROR(锚点))。没有公式不铺，别的公式报 NotImplemented。错误文字的字色和底色不同也报 NotImplemented，没写 patternType 只有 bgColor 的差分填充也当纯色。能看成数字的文字在格子左上角画 6 像素绿三角。筛选按钮 17×17，箭头居中。实线边框认 thin、medium、thick，各 1、2、3 像素，字色、填充和边框认 rgb、主题色和索引色，没写颜色时用黑色。边框只画在写下它的那一格上，不沿合并区扩开，合并区内部的边不画。线以边界为中线，偶数宽度多出的一像素落在坐标较小的一侧。线只伸到实际有边的那一端。更粗的线盖住交界。同样粗时右边缘盖住左边缘。更细的底边才让开左边那格：虚线让开全部厚度，实线让开一半。2 像素虚线的边界行再向右涂 1 像素。上面那一格有底边，或格子自己有上边时，竖线不涂上边界。两边都没有时，竖线从上边界涂起。虚线、点线、发丝、双线、点划线和斜点划线按整图坐标取余，发丝涂在偶数坐标，竖向 dashed 用 y 减 1，双线空出边界像素。两种纯色的图案按整图像素铺在填充矩形上，前景是点，背景是底，没写前景用黑，没写背景用白。认 gray125、gray0625、横竖线、网格、三种灰度、斜向和格纹。图案色的 rgb 前两位不是 FF 时不认。没有描边、没有字的纯色矩形按锚点画，上边和左边的外框盖住它。不透明 PNG 在目标像素正好等于要贴的像素时按原图贴上。srcRect 落到整像素且不缩放时贴这一块，百分比落在像素中间或还要缩放报 NotImplemented。旋转、翻转、描边和半透明也报 NotImplemented。其它压到区域上的图形、斜线、渐变填充、认不出的图案、条件格式里的图案和其它条件格式报 NotImplemented。宽或高超出 1 到 4096 像素也报 NotImplemented。docx 与 pptx 报 InvalidField。
exportSheetImageRequest.limitsEn: Read only. Does not modify the source package, and pixels do not enter inspect. id is sheet:{name}. The picture is the union of the dimension and the cell bounding box, or whichever one is present. Pixels follow Excel CopyPicture at 100 percent and do not multiply the sheet zoom. An explicit column width uses floor(((256*width+floor(128/7))/256)*7). An omitted column is 64 pixels. Row height truncates points to pixels. With no defaultRowHeight, an empty row is 14.25 pt (19 pixels). A written height is ignored unless customHeight is true, and an empty row then uses the Normal style. When customHeight is true, empty rows and Normal-font rows use that height. An empty row inside a merge grows with the anchor font. Automatic row height only treats CJK faces as 1.65 times the point size, and Calibri 11 pt as 15 pt. Width and height are the sums plus 1. The grid is E0E0E0. Solid fills cover the cell's right and bottom edges. The top and left outer frame stay the grid color. When showGridLines is 0 or false, the grid is not drawn, the frame stays white, and the size does not change. Hidden rows and columns take no pixels. When a whole side is hidden, that side is one white pixel. A conditional format that touches a hidden row or column still returns NotImplemented. When rightToLeft is set and there is no text, conditional format, or auto filter, the picture is flipped horizontally. Text still returns NotImplemented. A formula with a cache uses that cache. A formula without a cache uses the library evaluator. A merge uses its anchor. Data bars use min and max, from 10 percent to 90 percent. Two or three color-scale stops mix in RGB. An expression rule with a solid differential fills the cell when the formula evaluates to a non-zero value. A formula that cannot be evaluated returns NotImplemented. A formula differential border is painted like a cell border when that line style already matches. dashed and slantDashDot differential borders return NotImplemented. Above-average, top-N, and text rules paint a solid fill on the cells they hit. The standard deviation is the population figure. Duplicate and unique rules paint a solid fill. Blank rules accept only LEN(TRIM(anchor))=0 or >0 at the anchor. Error rules accept only ISERROR(anchor) or NOT(ISERROR(anchor)). A missing formula paints nothing, and any other formula is NotImplemented. Error text whose color differs from the fill is NotImplemented. A differential fill with only bgColor and no patternType is also solid. Text that parses as a number gets a 6-pixel green triangle at the top-left of the cell. Filter buttons are 17 by 17, with the arrow centered. Solid borders accept thin, medium, and thick, at 1, 2, and 3 pixels. Font, fill, and border colors accept rgb, a theme color, or an indexed color. A missing color is black. A border stays on the cell that has it, is not stretched around a merge, and an edge inside the merge is not drawn. The line is centered on the cell edge. An even width puts the extra pixel toward the smaller coordinate. A line stops at an end that has no border. A thicker line covers a thinner one on the same edge. At the same thickness, a right edge covers a left edge. A thinner bottom edge leaves room for the cell on its left: the full thickness after a dashed line, and half after a solid line. A two-pixel dash paints one more pixel to the right on the boundary row. A vertical line leaves the top boundary unpainted when the cell above has a bottom edge or this cell has a top edge, and paints the top boundary when neither exists. Dashed, dotted, hair, double, dash-dot, and slant-dash-dot lines follow the picture coordinate. Hair is on even coordinates. A vertical dashed line uses y minus 1. A double line leaves the boundary pixel blank. A two-color pattern uses the same rectangle as a solid fill and the picture's pixel coordinates. The foreground is the dot and the background is the field. A missing foreground is black and a missing background is white. Recognized patterns are gray125, gray0625, horizontal and vertical lines, grids, the three grays, diagonals, and trellises. A pattern rgb whose first two digits are not FF is rejected. A solid rectangle with no line and no text is drawn from its anchor. The top and left frame covers it. An opaque PNG is copied when the destination box equals the pixels being copied. An srcRect that lands on whole pixels and does not scale copies that window. A percentage between pixels, or a crop that still scales, is NotImplemented. Rotation, flipping, a stroke, or partial alpha is NotImplemented. Other drawings that hit the range, diagonal borders, gradient fills, unrecognized patterns, patterns inside conditional formats, and other conditional formats return NotImplemented. Width or height outside 1 to 4096 pixels also returns NotImplemented. docx and pptx return InvalidField.
exportSheetImageRequest.comment: output 必填。不得默认写成源 path。contentType 固定为 image/png。

exportPageImageRequest.description: 把 docx 里没有字的一页画成 PNG。
exportPageImageRequest.descriptionEn: Draw one docx page that has no text to a PNG.
exportPageImageRequest.limits: 只读。不改源包，像素不进 inspect。id 是 page:N，从 1 起。只画单节、空段、Calibri 11 磅、没有页眉页脚的白页。宽高按 w:pgSz，96 dpi，twip×96/1440 四舍五入，要落在 1 到 4096 像素。有字、表格、图、页眉页脚或别的行距报 NotImplemented。xlsx 与 pptx 报 InvalidField。
exportPageImageRequest.limitsEn: Read only. Does not modify the source package, and pixels do not enter inspect. id is page:N, starting at 1. Only a white page with one section, empty paragraphs, Calibri 11 pt, and no header or footer is drawn. Width and height come from w:pgSz at 96 dpi, rounding twip times 96/1440, and must be 1 to 4096 pixels. Text, tables, pictures, headers, footers, or another line spacing return NotImplemented. xlsx and pptx return InvalidField.
exportPageImageRequest.comment: output 必填。不得默认写成源 path。contentType 固定为 image/png。

exportSlideImageRequest.description: 把 pptx 一页的纯色页底、PNG 和没有描边的实心矩形画成 PNG。
exportSlideImageRequest.descriptionEn: Draw a pptx slide's solid background, PNG pictures, and solid rectangles without a stroke to a PNG.
exportSlideImageRequest.limits: 只读。不改源包，像素不进 inspect。页底用本页、版式或母版上没有颜色变换的不透明纯色，含主题色，没有或画不了时铺白。还画没有旋转翻转裁剪的 PNG，以及没有翻转、没有描边的不透明实心矩形，含绕中心转 90 度倍数。后画的盖住先画的，超出页面的部分裁掉。半透明、文字、其它形状和图表不画。组合里的图、视频和音频报 NotImplemented。宽或高超出 1 到 4096 像素也报 NotImplemented。xlsx 与 docx 报 InvalidField。
exportSlideImageRequest.limitsEn: Read only. Does not modify the source package, and pixels do not enter inspect. Opaque solid page backgrounds without a color transform, including theme colors, come from the slide, then the layout, then the master. Missing or unrecognized backgrounds stay white. Unrotated unflipped uncropped PNG pictures, and opaque solid rectangles without a flip or a stroke, are also drawn, including quarter turns around the center. Later objects cover earlier ones, and the part outside the page is clipped. Translucent fills, text, other shapes, and charts are not drawn. Pictures inside groups, video, and audio return NotImplemented. Width or height outside 1 to 4096 pixels also returns NotImplemented. xlsx and docx return InvalidField.
exportSlideImageRequest.comment: output 必填。不得默认写成源 path。contentType 固定为 image/png。

layoutCheckRequest.description: 只读检查页上形状的几何，不改文件。
layoutCheckRequest.descriptionEn: Check shape geometry on slides without changing the file.
layoutCheckRequest.limits: 不生成图片，不调用 Office，不重排。本期只做 pptx，其余格式报 InvalidField。
layoutCheckRequest.limitsEn: No images, no Office calls, no reflow. Only pptx is supported in this phase; other formats return InvalidField.

helpRequest.descriptionEn: Look up how to fill in an operation.
helpRequest.limits: 先搜再打开。不要猜字段，也不要把别的格式的字段套过来。本工具不支持预览。xlsx 的簇状柱形图可以按 exportChartImage 写成 PNG。xlsx 的折线迷你图可以按 exportSparklineImage 写成 PNG。xlsx 的已用区域可以按 exportSheetImage 写成 PNG。pptx 可以按 exportSlideImage 把页底、PNG、矩形、圆角矩形、椭圆、两色渐变、形状文字、簇状柱形图和纯色单元格的表写成图。画不了的对象让整页失败。docx 没有字的页可以按 exportPageImage 写成 PNG，有字的页还不画。像素不进 inspect。机器上有 Microsoft Office 或 WPS 时，可以自己导出后再查看：Word、Excel，以及 WPS 的 kwps、ket，用 ExportAsFixedFormat 写成 PDF；PowerPoint 和 WPS 的 kwpp 用幻灯片的 Export 写成 PNG。本工具不调用它们。
helpRequest.limitsEn: Search first, then open one operation. Do not guess fields, and do not reuse fields from another format. This tool does not preview a whole page. An xlsx clustered column chart can be written to PNG with exportChartImage. An xlsx line sparkline can be written to PNG with exportSparklineImage. An xlsx used range can be written to PNG with exportSheetImage. A pptx slide's background, PNG pictures, rectangles, rounded rectangles, ellipses, two-stop gradients, shape text, clustered column charts, and solid table cells can be written with exportSlideImage. An object that cannot be drawn fails the slide. Those pixels do not enter inspect. A docx page with no text can be written to PNG with exportPageImage. Pages with text are not drawn yet. If Microsoft Office or WPS is installed, export and then look: Word, Excel, and WPS kwps and ket use ExportAsFixedFormat to write a PDF; PowerPoint and WPS kwpp use the slide Export method to write a PNG. This tool does not call them.
